goal: a0 v0.1 — free-first, zero-dependency Node/ESM OpenAI-compatible gateway. Local, self-hosted, no auth service, no hosted instance. npm distribution. Pools keyless free lanes, enhances every prompt, routes by capability, races lanes in parallel.

blocked: npm publish needs a human: account access and final package name. Real keyed-lane verification (Groq/Gemini/OpenRouter/xKiro) needs the user's keys.
decisions: a0 is a provider, not an agent: clients own the agent loop
a0 modifies every request with an idempotent operating contract (enhancement is on by default)
capability gates are hard: no tools to chat-only lanes, no images to text-only lanes
race=2 by default (first usable byte wins, loser aborted); best-of available for non-stream, default off
streaming is the contract; no retry after bytes are sent
loopback by default; a token is auto-generated when binding beyond loopback
